structure.layout: single-column app with top navigation bar, full-width segmented tab strip (Text / Duckyscript), and a long stacked list of script rows in the Duckyscript panel

aesthetics.typography: Ubuntu Sans Mono for UI, buttons, list items and body; Roboto Mono bold for the 'ToothPaste' wordmark and section headings (h6) — fully monospaced interface
aesthetics.typeScale: 36px/700 wordmark, 20px/700-500 headings, 16px nav, 14px item titles/buttons/tabs, 12px muted metadata; modest contrast, hierarchy mainly via weight and white vs grey

notes: Terminal/hacker aesthetic: pure black background with a faint grid-line SVG pattern behind the main area, all-monospace type. Header nav uses outlined-white box for the active page ('Paste'); 'Connect to Device' is a 2px pink-red outlined button with a broadcast-off icon (click to connect, hold to rename). Full-width split action buttons: green 'New Script' and orange 'Import From .txt File'. Script rows are dense 68px full-width bordered rows with bold white title and grey '• '-separated meta (lines • ✓ Valid / ❌ Errors • ms). Detail (Edit Script) replaces list in place with back arrow, code textarea, stats footer and big 'Execute Script' button. Work-in-progress warning is plain red text with an info icon rather than a boxed alert.
